title: A valid-prefix output can prove an entire program tile has no observable writes
executor_revision: bw1100-bench frozen wave2 controls; self-contained HCU gateway, not canonical Lab Executor
observation: The frozen grouped MoE Schedule masks activation loads by device lengths but still executes the full fixed-grid IEEE dot. Its dense private outputs do not currently authorize pruning: masked input alone cannot erase observable output stores. The adapter only consumes valid routed rows, so a successor may declare the existing valid_extent relation on these private outputs, retain the same full operator contract and test whether empty program tiles can be removed.
proposed_change: Reuse valid_extent without new syntax. Derive one common scalar-indexed output prefix for ordinary output stores; guard a program only when every global effect is behind that same prefix. Keep dense outputs, atomic/state effects, mismatched output domains and persistent walks unchanged. Partial tiles retain their masks. Mark operation repetitions runtime-dependent so static work is not presented as exact. Device qualification must compare unchanged adapter composition, same IEEE precision, full original correctness and paired parent/community timing.
